additional_independent_tests.scope: Real output_writers logic over bounded injected synthetic JSON readers; no production receipts/guards. Synthetic file writes and both atomic-rename observation orders.

accepted_corrections: Original 655 final paths plus exactly18 immutable JSON staging slots mapped to outer/coordinator/rank0/rank1 writer roles; maximum673 files.

Staging filenames require exact original p.once basename, destination allowlist and the actual acknowledged writer PID; unknown/unacknowledged PID, command, parent/group mismatch or duplicate process roles rejected.
Current caller supplies original outer identity at all usage sites. Registry uses published admission and acknowledged coordinator/rank metadata; the existing lock/process guards remain active.
Pending files contribute actual max(st_size,st_blocks*512) to existing total and metadata caps; existing byte/resource caps remain unchanged.
Known pending-to-final disappearance follows its exact final path; device/inode de-duplication prevents counting the same atomic rename twice. Both before-lstat and after-observed orderings tested.
Snapshot reconstruction walks explicit manifest paths and validates exact complete leaf path set, preserving event ordering and rejecting extras or equal-shape K/V swaps.
Journal cross-linking follows manifest event/path order and passes sorted JSON roundtrip without weakening full payload/source/shape/layout checks.
